The '''A-5 envirosuit''' was an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] created by [[Malik Technologies]]. It gave the wearer protection from extreme temperature and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] exposure. It was the most popular suit available on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]].
